description: Lebanese Air Force de Havilland Vampire T.55, construction number 15484, in the single museum hangar at Rayak. Recorded as preserved by spottingmode and listed by both aviationmuseum.eu and the Wikipedia surviving-Vampire list. The spottingmode location record was last updated 17 October 2016.

Lebanese Air Force Hawker Hunter F.6 in the museum hangar at Rayak. Rayak also holds a wider grounded Hunter population outside the museum, three of which were returned to flying condition in 2008; this airframe is the one both spottingmode and aviationmuseum.eu place inside the museum. No construction number is published.
Lebanese Air Force Sud Aviation SE.3130 Alouette II preserved in the Rayak museum hangar. No construction number is published in either source that lists it.
Lebanese Air Force Sud Aviation SA.316B Alouette III, construction number 1980, preserved in the Rayak museum hangar.
Lebanese Air Force Agusta-Bell AB.212, construction number 32108, preserved in the Rayak museum hangar.

Lebanese Air Force Fouga CM.170 Magister, construction number 503, recorded as preserved in the Rayak museum collection by spottingmode. The aviationmuseum.eu list of the museum names only the second Magister, L-602, so the presence of this one rests on spottingmode alone.

Lebanese Air Force Fouga CM.170 Magister, construction number 505, at Rayak. Listed as a museum exhibit by aviationmuseum.eu but carried by spottingmode with the status stored rather than preserved, so it is recorded here as in storage.

Lebanese Air Force Aerospatiale SA.342L Gazelle, construction number 1824, at Rayak. Listed as a museum exhibit by aviationmuseum.eu but carried by spottingmode with the status stored rather than preserved.
Lebanese Air Force Aerospatiale SA.342L Gazelle, construction number 1681, recorded as preserved in the Rayak museum hangar by both spottingmode and aviationmuseum.eu.
